representative_methods: source reuse; target-only recalibration; history-assisted recalibration; ASRC; unified auditor
theory_condition_tested: target evidence identifiability margin and incremental value
expected_success_channel: target labels restore safe lower-cost action
observed_evidence: fixed-target recalibration reached low risk in paired settings; strict disjoint designs weakened gains; history added about zero with intervals crossing zero; auditor often selected maximum budget
failure_point: economic and incremental-value failure plus earlier query-reuse/margin confounding
scientific_interpretation: target evidence can recover fixed-target safety but does not imply transportability or net value

expected_success_channel: safe selection finds or construction creates a Pareto action
observed_evidence: CIBS had zero jointly feasible CI-supported SIFT actions and zero Arxiv CI-supported actions; CFSR worsened B_exp and B_ef; O4/O6 produced no Pareto smoke signal
failure_point: candidate pool lacked joint feasibility and structural proxies did not control native budget response
scientific_interpretation: safe selection cannot create a missing action and graph similarity is not a general response certificate

representative_methods: CALS; fixed portal sets; additive rescue; BN-APD; shared-frontier audit
theory_condition_tested: failure complementarity observable triggering and cost realizability
expected_success_channel: auxiliary lane rescues primary failures only when useful
observed_evidence: fixed portals produced positive rescue on all registered builds; absolute risk remained above five percent; cost was about 2.77x/2.47x matched single-lane; no truth-free trigger passed; required compression was 79.5%-93.4%
failure_point: observable trigger and economic feasibility failed despite real complementarity
scientific_interpretation: conditional rescue is necessary but not sufficient for a deployable multi-lane method

representative_methods: unified certified auditor; Bonferroni-CP certification; fallback ladder; abstention
theory_condition_tested: valid fixed-target certification fallback and decision value
expected_success_channel: never accept unsafe actions while choosing cheaper certified action
observed_evidence: alignment checks passed; unsafe acceptance could be zero; decisions frequently collapsed to maximum registered budget fallback or abstention; fixed-target regret remained positive
failure_point: valid fallback or abstention preserved safety but erased economic decision value
scientific_interpretation: safety certification is a method contribution distinct from successful optimization
